comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: moveCardKeyboard action is missing the recalculateColumnCounts side effect. Wiring that in now.

content.text: moveCardKeyboard action is missing the recalculateColumnCounts side effect. Wiring that in now.

Kanban column headers show a live card count. Dragging a card with the mouse updates both source and destination counts immediately. Moving a card with keyboard shortcuts (Focus card then Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+Arrow) updates the card position but leaves the header counts unchanged until a full board refresh.
Counts should stay consistent regardless of input method. Keyboard moves go through board.moveCard which updates column arrays but skips the columnMeta.counts reducer that the drag-end path calls.

Teams that rely on keyboard navigation for accessibility see wrong WIP totals and sometimes pull more work into a column that already looks full by count. Aligning the keyboard path with the same count mutation as pointer drag should close the gap.
